name: Unlisted Scraper
description: Dumps everything the servers will give up about a user's levels, then ID-probes around known uploads to surface unlisted ones.

auto-scan.name: Auto-scan on profile open
auto-scan.description: Start a scan automatically whenever a profile page loads.

probe-range.name: Probe radius
probe-range.description: How many level IDs to check on each side of every known level ID.

max-probes.name: Max probes
max-probes.description: Hard cap on total ID probes per scan.

delay.name: Request delay (ms)
delay.description: Gap between requests. Below ~150ms the server starts throwing -1s.

scan-comments.name: Scrape profile comments for IDs
scan-comments.description: Creators often drop unlisted IDs in comments. Slower but worth it.
